The sloping garden makes it virtually impossible for him to get around outside in a wheelchair, so the team sets about transforming the challenging patch to suit Malcolm's needs

event.name: Garden Rescue
event.description: Five years ago, David and John hoped the team could change their long plot into somewhere suitable for their wedding. Charlie Dimmock goes back to Shoreham-by-Sea in West Sussex to find the formal garden she designed and built has grown into something completely different as the middle section is now a secret garden hidden from view. Inspired by their hard work at keeping the garden, Charlie helps the couple add to it. The presenter also checks in with Kim in Cwmcarn, Monmouthshire, the owner of the steepest garden the team ever built, and a garden in Cosham, Hampshire, that helped one man on the road to recovery
